subject: ss-critical-care
title: Viral pneumonia and pandemic critical care

steps.tx: **RECOVERY** showed that **dexamethasone** 6 mg daily for up to 10 days reduced 28 day mortality in COVID-19 patients who needed oxygen or ventilation. Patients who did not need oxygen were not helped. Suppressing hyperinflammatory cytokine storms and blunting secondary lung injury saves lives exclusively in those with significant respiratory impairment.

steps.tx: **REMAP-CAP** found that **tocilizumab** improved outcomes in critically ill COVID-19. **Baricitinib** is an alternative immunomodulator in patients with progressing disease and inflammation. Targeted inhibition of interleukin-6 receptors or Janus kinase pathways curbs systemic hyperinflammation and accelerates recovery when added to baseline glucocorticoid therapy in worsening viral hypoxaemic failure.

rows: REMAP-CAP showed reduced organ support days and mortality
Selective JAK1 and JAK2 kinase inhibitor
Initiate within 24 to 48 hours of rapid clinical deterioration

steps.tx: COVID-19 ARDS is still ARDS for the ventilator: 6 mL/kg predicted body weight, **plateau pressure** at most 30 cmH2O, and **prone positioning** when the **PaO2/FiO2** is below 150. Despite early claims of unique physiological phenotypes, standard lung protective ventilation and prolonged prone sessions for 16 consecutive hours confer proven survival advantages.

left.title: Low tidal volume ventilation
points: Set strictly to 6 mL/kg predicted body weight
Maintains end-inspiratory plateau pressure at or below 30 cmH2O
Prevents cyclic alveolar overdistension and volutrauma

right.title: Prone positioning protocol
points: Mandated for severe ARDS with PaO2/FiO2 below 150
Delivered in sustained cycles of at least 16 hours
Promotes dorsal recruitment and balances transpulmonary gradients

steps.tx: **Awake prone positioning** is used in hypoxaemic COVID-19 before intubation. It does not replace intubation when the work of breathing is rising. While turning awake patients into the prone position improves arterial oxygen saturation and reduces subjective dyspnoea, clinicians must not overlook exhausting respiratory efforts and impending muscular fatigue.

rows: Recruits dorsal lung segments and improves V/Q ratio
Sustained tachypnoea or diaphoresis warrants intubation
Combined with HFNO or CPAP interfaces
ROX index below 3.85 indicates imminent failure
Immediate transition to invasive mechanical ventilation

steps.tx: **Oseltamivir** is given for severe **influenza** even when symptom onset was more than 48 hours earlier. Antibiotics are added only when bacterial coinfection is likely, not as a reflex. Neuraminidase inhibitors continue to reduce viral shedding and ICU length of stay in critically ill patients presenting beyond the traditional outpatient therapeutic window.

left.title: Oseltamivir in severe influenza
points: Initiate immediately in suspected or confirmed severe cases
Clinical benefit documented beyond standard 48-hour cut-off
Administer via enteral tube at standard 75 mg twice daily

right.title: Bacterial coinfection management
points: Secondary Staphylococcus aureus or Streptococcus pneumoniae
Prescribe targeted antibiotics for lobar consolidation

steps.tx: Routine antibacterial therapy and routine therapeutic anticoagulation are not treatments for viral pneumonia. **Prophylactic anticoagulation** still applies unless bleeding forbids it. Microvascular pulmonary immunothrombosis occurs frequently in severe viral pneumonia, but full therapeutic dosing failed to demonstrate benefit in critically ill patients in the multiplatform trials.

rows: Pure viral pneumonitis does not benefit from antibiotics
Mandatory to prevent deep vein thrombosis and PE
Trials showed increased major bleeding without mortality benefit

steps.tx: Surge triage uses a published framework and a physiology score such as **SOFA**. It does not use **social worth**. The same rules apply to every patient when crisis standards are declared. Ethical crisis resource allocation requires transparent, objective scoring systems evaluated by independent triage officers to distribute scarce intensive care beds equitably.

left.title: Objective physiological scoring
points: Assesses short-term survivability and organ dysfunction
Re-evaluated dynamically during ongoing ICU treatment

right.title: Ethical triage principles
points: Absolute prohibition on social worth or discrimination
Separation of bedside clinician from triage decision officer
Application of consistent crisis standard protocols

steps.tx: Staff protection is fit tested respiratory protection for **aerosol generating procedures**, including intubation. A viral pandemic plan names the device, the team, and the doffing area before the patient arrives. High-filtration N95 or FFP3 respirators, eye protection, and supervised doffing protocols eliminate hospital-acquired transmission to healthcare personnel.
